title: Accepting a Renewal Offer Before Contract End: Small Business Electricity Supply Representative Tool
content:
Under Small Business Electricity Supply, a business that explicitly accepts its renewal offer on or before the contract end date takes the plan and the term offered in the final options notice, its renewal election becomes accepted, and the renewed term carries the renewal rate worked out for that acceptance. The renewed term starts on the day after the contract end date and ends on the day before the same calendar day the renewed term's months later; when that calendar day does not exist in the target month, the last day of that month is used before the day is subtracted.

## Renewed term dates (hypothetical)

| Contract end date | Term offered | Renewed term starts | Same calendar day, term's months later | Renewed term ends |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 31 December 2026 | 36 months | 1 January 2027 | 1 January 2030 | 31 December 2029 |
| 28 February 2027 | 12 months | 1 March 2027 | 1 March 2028 | 29 February 2028 |

## Tool: `accept_renewal_offer_d4784688`

**Use and capability.** The business's authorized representative explicitly accepts the renewal offer on one of its small business electricity agreements while its current term is still in force. The agreement keeps its agreement number and site and is set to continue into the renewed plan: the plan name, term length, renewal rate, start date and end date of the renewed term are recorded on the agreement, the renewal election is recorded as accepted with today's date, and the term is marked as explicitly accepted rather than automatically renewed. The representative sees the agreement continuing into the renewed plan at the accepted rate on the next statement.

**How it is invoked.** This tool belongs to the business. The agent unlocks `accept_renewal_offer_d4784688` and hands it over; the customer themselves, through the business's authorized representative, runs it.

**Parameters.**

- `bizpower_agreement_id`: the agreement number of the small business electricity agreement being renewed, as shown on the agreement record returned by the agreement lookup.
- `renewed_plan_name`: the official plan the agreement continues into, written exactly as one of: Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable (the month-to-month plan, used only when the offer being accepted names that plan); Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 12 (the offer names the 12-month fixed plan); Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 24 (the 24-month fixed plan); Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 36 (the 36-month fixed plan); Beacon Ridge Business Green 24 (the 24-month renewable plan); Beacon Ridge Business Green 36 (the 36-month renewable plan).
- `term_months`: the length of the renewed term in integer months, without units or decimals (for example 36).
- `renewal_rate_cents_kwh`: the supply rate of the renewed term in cents per kWh, a decimal number with 2 decimal places (for example 8.75), already rounded half up to the cent.
- `new_term_start_date`: the start date of the renewed term, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `new_contract_end_date`: the end date of the renewed term, YYYY-MM-DD.

**Return.** A receipt with `agreement_id` (the agreement renewed), `status` (`renewal_accepted` when the acceptance was recorded), `plan` (the plan in force from the renewed term), `term_months`, `rate_cents_kwh` (the accepted rate, 2 decimals), `term_start`, `term_end` (both YYYY-MM-DD) and `accepted_on` (the date the acceptance was recorded, YYYY-MM-DD).
